excerpts.raw_ocr_excerpt:
Section 1.
The water system development Fee Schedule previously approved by
Resolution WWE-2 on June 28, 2022, is amended by combining the existing schedule lines for
"Development" and for "Large Development," into a single schedule line entitled simply
"Development," and establishing the development fee for that single category as $11,475 per
EQR.
